title: The unbiased estimation of the fraction of variance explained by a model
one_line_what_it_does: Unbiased estimator of r^2 between model predictions and the expected (noise-free) response from noisy trial-averaged responses, with CIs and asymptotics; SNR metric
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Core estimand+estimator: disattenuated correlation with latent rate, CI, noise ceiling; neuro spike counts with repeated trials, not thinning

title: Measuring the Performance of Neural Models
one_line_what_it_does: CC_norm = CC_abs/CC_max with ceiling from trial repeats
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Noise-ceiling-normalised correlation; per-unit ceiling; needs repeats

title: Quantifying variability in neural responses and its application for the validation of model predictions
one_line_what_it_does: Explainable variance / CCmax upper bound from inter-trial variability
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Origin of noise ceiling for model validation

title: Unbiased test error estimation in the Poisson means problem via coupled bootstrap techniques
one_line_what_it_does: Binomial thinning of Poisson counts into independent train/test; unbiased test error (squared/deviance) for arbitrary mean estimator
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Binomial thinning to evaluate arbitrary predictors of Poisson means; MSE not correlation

title: Data thinning for convolution-closed distributions

bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Thinning engine for Poisson/NB incl. evaluation

title: Negative binomial count splitting for single-cell RNA sequencing data

bears_on_which_part_of_claim: NB thinning for overdispersed counts (needs dispersion)

title: Data fission: splitting a single data point
one_line_what_it_does: General randomised splitting of a single observation

bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Epsilon tradeoff for thinning validation; Gaussian area-level data, MSE not correlation

title: Molecular Cross-Validation for Single-Cell RNA-seq
one_line_what_it_does: Binomial splitting of UMI counts into train/validation for denoising evaluation
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Original molecular thinning for evaluating predictors of expression (loss, not correlation)

one_line_what_it_does: Poisson measurement model with depth; unbiased estimate of correlation between latent expression levels, with test
